name: Game Studio
description: Independent tenant game creation, conversational design, authored levels, isolated playtests, public editions, shared arcade scores, customizable badging and exact-origin host integrations. Installing this package registers Core identity only; infrastructure deployment is separate.

permissions.name: Play published games and save shared arcade scores
Administer game creation and private drafts
Manage Game Studio content, branding and creation settings
Configure Game Studio agents and workflows
Manage Game Studio accounts and invitations

account_roles.name: Player
account_roles.description: Play published games and save shared arcade scores without game creation access.

account_roles.name: Game creation administrator
account_roles.description: Create private games and review isolated playtests.

account_roles.name: Game publishing administrator
account_roles.description: Create, playtest and publish reviewed game editions.

account_roles.name: Game Studio administrator
account_roles.description: Manage games, branding, creation settings, agents and application accounts.
